=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:284-291 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The subprocess inherits `PYTHONSAFEPATH=1`, which removes the mock server’s script directory from `sys.path`, causing its sibling-module import to fail and the handshake probe to return non-zero.
  WHY: The claimed environment-copy/removal patch is absent, so CI would fail on the new regression test.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2531 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Dispatched reviews check out `github.sha` rather than the PR head SHA, so reviewers read default-branch files while reviewing the PR diff.
  WHY: The gate does not produce `review_checkout_sha`, and the checkout step lacks the SHA-consistency check and `AUTOFIX_STALE_BASE_SKIP` short-circuit.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:codex-agent job steps between "Checkout repo" and "Run reviewer models" | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The OpenCode-configuration rejection and safe-path Python guard steps are absent, leaving the credential-bearing checkout exposed to project configuration/plugin execution and PR-tree module imports during host-side bootstrap.
  WHY: The trust-boundary guards the PR was supposed to install before agent setup are not present.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Make the reviewers (and any other agent step that reads files) run in the directory that holds the PR head: WORKSPACE_PATH when the workspace split is active, or check out the PR head into GITHUB_WORKSPACE for dispatched runs too (the gate already resolves head_sha). A `workflow_dispatch` review of a PR whose head adds a file sees that file in the reviewer workspace. No reviewer-file-read path depends on `github.sha` for a PR review." (issue #5824 body and acceptance criteria)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` — the gate job must export `review_checkout_sha` (a 40-hex SHA validated against `pr_head_repo_gate == REPOSITORY` and `pr_state == "open"`); the `codex-agent` job's "Checkout repo" step must use `ref: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.review_checkout_sha || github.sha }}` instead of `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}`; the checkout step must compare `review_source_sha`, `review_workspace_sha`, `review_metadata_sha`, and `REVIEW_CHECKOUT_SHA`, exporting `AUTOFIX_STALE_BASE_SKIP=true` on mismatch; the agent setup must require an existing `WORKSPACE_PATH`, reject project OpenCode configuration, and require safe-path Python.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `grep -n review_checkout_sha` returns zero matches across the entire repository; `grep -n PYTHONSAFEPATH` returns zero matches in `scripts/`, `prompts/`, and the workflow files; `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2531` still contains the pre-PR `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}`; neither the "Reject project OpenCode configuration" step nor the "Require safe-path Python" step is present between "Checkout repo" and "Run reviewer models"; no `AUTOFIX_STALE_BASE_SKIP` write inside the checkout step exists (the variable only appears in pre-existing `if:` predicates on later steps).
